title: The Best Semester
author: Lena Ashgrove
blurb: Hazel Hartwell, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide who to be when the labels come off before graduation.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
